title: MSRUAS Digital Health Center: MoU with Dean & ICMR Grant Review
venue: Board Room / MSRUAS Health Sciences Campus
chair: Dr. G. Hari Prakash (Chair / Lead PI)
agenda_items: MoU ratification and governance alignment
Budget allocations across compute nodes and research staff
Field deployment and clinical data protocol finalization
executive_summary: The meeting was convened under the chairmanship of Dr. G. Hari Prakash (Chair / Lead PI) on Friday, August 21, 2026 to deliberate on strategic milestones, execution roadmaps, and resource governance.
All present members unanimously ratified the proposed execution blueprint and approved a total resource allocation of INR 2,500,000.
Specific accountability owners and rigorous milestone deadlines were assigned across ethical clearances, infrastructure hosting, research personnel recruitment, and client deliverables.
The committee affirmed its commitment to high-rigor standards, scheduled weekly asynchronous tracking, and set the next formal review for the subsequent cycle.
decisions_logged: Formal approval granted for the comprehensive project methodology and execution timeline.
Resource allocation of INR 2,500,000 formally endorsed and sanctioned.
Dedicated task force constituted with assigned responsibilities and strict time-bound deliverables.
Agreement reached on ethical compliances, data security governance, and multi-stakeholder reporting protocols.

discussion_sections.summary: The Chair, Dr. G. Hari Prakash (Chair / Lead PI), welcomed the esteemed members and outlined the paramount strategic objectives. The agenda was formally adopted without amendments.

Detailed discussions were held on data architectures, clinical validation protocols, AI modeling pipelines, and community outreach frameworks. Consensus was reached on adopting high-availability infrastructure.
The financial committee reviewed the itemized cost breakdown. Approved expenditures total INR 2,500,000 across hardware, human resources, field execution, and dissemination.
Potential operational bottlenecks were evaluated with mitigation safeguards. All members agreed on continuous audit mechanisms and bi-weekly milestone checkpoints.

action_items.task: Submit the finalized Institutional Ethics Committee (IEC) documentation and clinical trial registry dossier.
Finalize MoU terms with Dean of Academics regarding GPU server hosting in the MSRUAS Digital Health Center.
Complete candidate screening for 2 Junior Research Fellows (JRF) in Public Health Epidemiology.
Deploy community field-survey tablets with offline encrypted sync for the peri-urban cohort study.

budget_allocations.category: Cloud Computing & AI Servers (Digital Health Lab)
budget_allocations.remarks: High-throughput GPU nodes for epidemiology modeling
Stipends for 2 JRF positions for 12 months
MSRUAS community health outreach in Bengaluru peri-urban areas
High-impact Lancet / BMC Public Health journal fees
Dean's office discretionary fund
